mostWorthwhile.text: Making the new stellar nursery was the strongest payoff: it connected the star's destruction to future worlds.

leastWorthwhile.text: Creating the expanding remnant was a relatively thin transition; it fit the idea of dispersal but offered little detail on its own.

surprise.text: The glowing nebula clarified that light reveals a cloud rather than creating a new substance, and the heavy-elements passage separated their formation from their later dispersal.

arbitrary.text: Adding light to the remnant felt somewhat unclear beforehand; the result explained that it made the cloud visible.

continue.text: I would continue: the nursery suggests a promising route from stellar remains to rocky worlds, though the mostly forced choices made this chapter less engaging as a puzzle.
